channel.description: Daily Trending of C Languages in GitHub

item.title: FareedKhan-dev / kimi-k3-in-c
item.description: A 2.78-trillion-parameter Kimi K3 running inference on a single CPU in 8.24 GB of RAM. Portable C99: no BLAS, no framework, no GPU.

item.title: JustVugg / colibri
item.description: A hierarchical inference engine for frontier MoE models: hot experts on the GPU (CUDA, Vulkan), warm ones in RAM, cold ones streamed from NVMe. Written in C, runs on the hardware you already own.

item.title: dorianborian / sesame-robot
item.description: An open and affordable mini quadruped robot based on ESP32.

item.title: radareorg / radare2
item.description: UNIX-like reverse engineering framework and command-line toolset

item.title: YizhengWw / HachimoDock
item.description: A desktop pet that reacts to your Claude Code sessions in real-time — thinking, typing, juggling, sleeping, and more.

item.title: Serial-Studio / Serial-Studio
item.description: Open-source telemetry dashboard. Supports UART, BLE, MQTT, Modbus, CAN Bus and more.
